breakdown.description: Sudden expansion causes irreversible mixing and head loss; Bernoulli (lossless) cannot be applied directly across the expansion without including the loss term.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly uses 'Bernoulli's equation (ideal, no losses)' and makes no mention of the Borda–Carnot head loss h_L = (V1 - V2)^2/(2g). It repeats and even reinforces the original error by emphasizing the lossless assumption, directly contradicting the ground truth which requires accounting for irreversible head loss in the sudden expansion.
